people.emptyHint: Add your staff to mark attendance and run payroll.
people.attendanceHint: Unmarked days count as present in payroll. Approved leave is marked automatically.

leave.title: Leave
leave.subtitle: Requests, approvals and balances
leave.balanceHint: Days left of the yearly quota (paid leave with a quota)
leave.quotaHint: A new quota applies to balances not yet opened for the year. Unpaid leave is deducted in payroll.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Monthly salary from attendance, leave and salary structures
payroll.emptyHint: Pick a month and run payroll; you can adjust before finalizing.
payroll.skipped: No salary structure, so not in this payroll: {{names}}.
payroll.adjustHint: This month's incentive, bonus and deductions. Recalculating keeps them.
payroll.payHint_one: {{count}} slip is not paid yet. One payment per person is recorded.
payroll.payHint_other: {{count}} slips are not paid yet. One payment per person is recorded.

packing.title: Packing
packing.subtitle: Confirmed orders to pack, batches first to expire, packing slips
packing.scan: Scan a barcode or type a product
packing.fefoHint: Batch-tracked items are picked from the batch that expires first.
packing.unpackedDone: Unpacked; the order is back to packing

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.subtitle: Trips, vehicles, drivers and deliveries
dispatch.readyHint: Posted bills of the last 60 days that are not on a trip. Pick them in delivery order.
dispatch.nothingReadyHint: New bills show up here until they are put on a trip.

analytics.profitHint: Sales are before GST and net of returns, discounts and rate differences; cost is the average purchase cost when each item was sold.
analytics.pnlHint: Salaries are counted for finalized payroll months in the period
analytics.movementHint: Fast: the products making the first 80% of sales. Not moving: in stock but not sold in the period. Days of cover: how long the stock lasts at this period's pace.

billImport.title: Import supplier bill
billImport.hint: Upload the bill your supplier sent: Excel, CSV or the PDF from their billing software. Items, quantities, rates, GST, batch and expiry are read and matched to your products; you check everything before saving.
billImport.columnsHelp: Columns it understands (any usual name): bill no, bill date, supplier GSTIN or name, item name, item code, barcode, HSN, unit, qty, free qty, rate / PTR, disc %, GST % (or CGST % + SGST %, IGST %), batch, expiry, MRP, taxable value.
billImport.noHeader: No header row with an item name and a quantity column was found in the first 20 rows.
billImport.noItems: The file has a header but no item rows.
billImport.billsInFile_other: {{count}} bills in this file. Pick the one to enter:
billImport.tooManyLines: This bill has {{count}} items; up to {{max}} can be entered on one purchase. Split the file.
billImport.problems_one: {{count}} cell could not be read and was left out:
billImport.problems_other: {{count}} cells could not be read and were left out:
billImport.reviewHint: Check quantities, rates and GST against the bill before saving. The item matches you keep are remembered for this supplier's next bill.
billImport.supplierNotFound: Supplier not found in your list: {{value}}. Pick the supplier, or add them first.
billImport.duplicate: Bill {{number}} from this supplier is already entered ({{ours}}). Saving it again will be refused.
billImport.toMatchHint: Pick your product for each item on the supplier's bill, add it as a new product, or leave it out.
billImport.unmatchedLeft_one: Match or leave out the {{count}} remaining item first
billImport.unmatchedLeft_other: Match or leave out the {{count}} remaining items first
billImport.newProductsTitle: Add new products from the bill
billImport.newProductsHint: These items are not in your product list. Their name, GST, unit, rate, MRP and HSN come from the bill; check the selling price, then add them. They go on this purchase straight away.
billImport.looksLike: Looks like your “{{name}}”: match it instead, or tick to add as new
billImport.packAboveMrp: Billed per {{unit}} above its MRP, so the MRP is probably per piece. Check the unit and price.
billImport.gstForRest: GST for the items without one
billImport.rateNotListed: The bill charges GST {{rates}}, which is not in your GST list (rates changed on 22 Sep 2025). Choose the rate that applies now; this purchase keeps the GST the bill charged.
billImport.billRate: Bill: GST {{rate}}%, not in your list

offline.notReady: This device is not ready for offline bills yet. Open Digital Bahi once while connected to the internet.
offline.banner: No connection. Bills, payments, orders and customer changes are saved on this device and sent when the internet is back.
offline.title: Waiting on this device
offline.description: Work done without a connection waits here until the server takes it: bills keep the number printed on them, a new customer keeps what was billed to them.
offline.noDevice: This device has no offline bill series yet. It gets one the next time it connects.
offline.removeConfirm: Remove bill {{number}}? It will not reach the books, and its number stays unused.
offline.signOutOffline: Connect to the internet to sign out.
offline.signOutPending_one: {{count}} change is still waiting to sync. It stays on this device and is sent the next time you sign in here. Sign out anyway?
offline.signOutPending_other: {{count}} changes are still waiting to sync. They stay on this device and are sent the next time you sign in here. Sign out anyway?

devices.title: Devices for offline billing
devices.help: Phones and computers that can make bills without internet. Each has its own bill series (A1, A2 …). Remove a lost or old device so it cannot send bills.
devices.empty: No device has been set up yet. A phone or computer is added when someone who makes bills signs in on it.
devices.name: Device
devices.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} (series {{code}})? Bills it has not sent yet will be refused.

offline.removeEntryConfirm: Remove this {{what}} ({{name}})? It will not reach the books.
offline.removeCustomerConfirm: Remove the new customer {{name}}? Bills, payments and orders for them that are still waiting cannot be sent then.
offline.conflict: Someone changed this customer on another device after you. Keep yours to save your change over theirs, or remove yours to keep theirs.
offline.sendsLater: It goes to the server when the internet is back.
offline.paymentNote: No connection: the payment is saved on this device and, when it reaches the server, goes to the oldest bills first.
offline.orderNote: No connection: the order is saved on this device and priced by the server when it arrives.
offline.customerNote: No connection: saved on this device and sent when the internet is back.
offline.notReadyWork: This device cannot keep work offline (its storage is blocked). Connect to the internet and try again.

passwordSetup.title: Open without internet
passwordSetup.body: When this device starts without internet it asks for your password. You signed in without it here, so confirm it once.
passwordSetup.done: This device now opens without internet with your password.

messages.reminder: Namaste {{party}}, a reminder from {{business}}: {{balance}} is due, of which {{overdue}} is overdue since {{since}}. Please pay at the earliest. Thank you.
messages.reminderBalance: Namaste {{party}}, a reminder from {{business}}: your balance is {{balance}}. Thank you.
messages.test: This is a test message from {{business}} on Digital Bahi. WhatsApp and email are set up.
messages.title: WhatsApp & email
messages.subtitle: Bills, receipts and payment reminders sent to customers from your own WhatsApp Business number and email
messages.toOnFile: The one saved for the party
messages.attachment: The PDF {{name}} goes with the message.
messages.notReady: Not set up yet. The owner can set it up in Settings → WhatsApp & email.
messages.testMode: Test mode: messages are recorded here but not sent (the server runs with MESSAGING_DRIVER=log).
messages.remindersHint: Customers who owe you money. Tick whom to remind; the messages go out one after another from your WhatsApp Business number or email.
messages.noCandidates: No customer owes you money right now.

settings.title: WhatsApp & email
settings.hint: Send bills, receipts and reminders from your own WhatsApp Business number and email. Tokens and passwords are stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.secretSet: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
settings.documentTemplate: Template for bills (with a document header)
settings.templateHelp: WhatsApp only lets businesses start a chat with an approved template. Bills template: {{1}} party, {{2}} number, {{3}} amount, {{4}} your firm, with a document header. Reminder template: {{1}} party, {{2}} balance, {{3}} overdue, {{4}} your firm. Without templates, messages reach only customers who wrote to you in the last 24 hours.
settings.platformMissing: This server has no mail server set up (SMTP_URL and MAIL_FROM). Use your own SMTP instead.
settings.testTo: Mobile or email for a test
settings.ticksMeta: In your Meta app → WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook, paste this callback URL and verify token, subscribe to "messages", and save the app secret (App settings → Basic) here. Messages then show delivered and read.
settings.ticksProvider: Give this address to your provider for status updates. They sign them with the same secret as the messages we send them.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Keep a copy of your whole book: customers, products, bills, payments, stock, GST, salary and settings
backup.downloadHint: One file with everything in this business. Keep it on a pen drive or in your email, away from this computer.
backup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Without the password nobody can open the file, not even us, so write it down.
backup.passwordIfAny: The file's password (if it has one)
backup.noPasswordWarning: Without a password anyone who gets the file can read your customers, bills and accounts. A password is recommended.
backup.emailHint: The backup goes as an attachment, always with a password.
backup.historyHint: Who made a backup and when. The files themselves are only with you.
backup.restoreHint: A backup is always restored as a NEW business next to this one. Nothing in the current business is changed or deleted.
backup.understand: I understand this creates a new business “{{name}}” (a fresh trial from {{today}}); the current business stays as it is.
backup.accountPasswordHint: The password you sign in with, to confirm it is you.

auto.title: Automatic backups
auto.hint: A password-protected copy is emailed on its own every day or week, so a copy stays safe even if this computer is lost.
auto.toNeeded: The firm has no email in Settings; type one here.
auto.passwordSaved: A password is saved. Type a new one only to change it.
auto.lastFailed: The backup of {{when}} was not sent: {{reason}}
auto.setUpBy: Set up by {{name}}; the copies go out in their name.
auto.emailNotReady: Email is not set up yet. Set it up in Settings → WhatsApp & email, then turn on automatic backups.

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.hint: Each customer buys on one list (Price A, B, C…). The default list is the product's selling price and is what new customers get; set the other lists' prices on each product.
priceLists.name: Name of

unlock.title: Open {{business}} without internet
unlock.hint: The copy on this device is locked. Type {{name}}'s Digital Bahi password to open it.
unlock.wrong: This password does not open the copy on this device. If you changed your password recently, use the one you had when this device was last online.
unlock.noPassword: This copy opens without internet only after you have signed in with your password on this device once. Connect to the internet to continue.
unlock.why: Your customers, bills and accounts are kept on this device encrypted, so nobody can read them from a lost phone or a copied browser.

collect.title: Outstanding
collect.subtitle: Money to collect from customers, place by place
collect.emptyHint: Customers with a balance show here, with their city and route.
collect.offlineNote: No connection: amounts from the copy on this device. Bills and downloads need the internet; print and CSV work.
collect.noOpenBills: No open bills; the balance is from the opening balance or other entries.
collect.billsNeedInternet: The bills show when you are online.
collect.amountHint: Leave empty for the full amount
collect.provisionalHint: Saved on this phone. The receipt number comes when it syncs; the customer can be given this now.
